verdict.rationale: Reflect documents an OAuth2 REST API with a published OpenAPI spec that supports headless writing: POST /graphs/{graphId}/notes to create notes and PUT /graphs/{graphId}/daily-notes to append to daily notes. The vendor states explicitly that because notes are end-to-end encrypted, 'we can't serve them up in the API,' so an agent can only read bookmarked links, graphs and user info, not note contents. That covers only the write half of the story. Missing for 10: API read access to note contents, an MCP server or local API, and API versioning or sandbox docs.
